prospects.reason: Direct niche match; potential freelance support with launch funnels, copy, emails and Meta campaigns. Partnership availability is not yet confirmed.
prospects.message:
Hey Petrovic Management team! Hope you’re doing well. Your work marketing digital courses, memberships and high-ticket coaching caught my eye.

I work with coaches and thought leaders to launch and scale their offers through Meta ads, funnels, virtual events, emails, copywriting, brand messaging, tech and automations.

I wanted to reach out to see if your team ever brings in freelance support for client delivery—whether that’s a launch, funnel build, email sequence or campaign execution. I’d love to share my portfolio and see where my experience could complement your team.

Would that be useful right now, or is there someone on your team I should speak with? Happy to connect :)
